description: This file defines a Java interface `LoggerConfig` for configuring loggers, including methods to get log level and logger name, along with related JSON schema definitions.

classes.name: LoggerConfig
classes.description: An interface for accessing configuration of loggers, providing methods to retrieve log level and logger name, and to convert the config to JSON.

classes.name: LoggerConfig.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for LoggerConfig.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the LogLevel to set for the logger.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger's name to change, if specified.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of this LoggerConfig, including only non-hidden fields.
